consensus_strengths: Coherent finite-pool, realized-schedule estimand with appropriately bounded descriptive claims.
Internally consistent arithmetic, contrast directions, and subgroup aggregation.
Unusually explicit separation of defined versus disclosed arms, nominal draws versus invocation counts, and descriptive evidence versus inference.
Readable, anonymous, page-compliant presentation with clear limitations and AI-use disclosure.
consensus_weaknesses: All central empirical values are source-reported and cannot be replayed: raw records, implementations, configurations, stochastic traces, and evidence-ID crosswalks are absent.
The s_conf selection-versus-scoring passes and claimed 2L invocation accounting are underdefined and uninstrumented; this is cannot_verify, not a demonstrated miscount.
The evaluated-arm, budget, schedule, failure, and decision ledger is incomplete, leaving selection risk unresolved despite responsible exploratory labels.
Evidence is confined to one checkpoint/task and unavailable single stochastic realizations, sharply limiting stability and significance.
The closest-work and bibliography audit is explicitly incomplete.

positions: The clarity reviewer assigns 4 and a ceiling of 4 because the claims are carefully bounded and the presentation itself is verifiable.
The other four reviewers assign 2 and ceilings of 2 because an empirical conference contribution cannot rest entirely on unreplayable source-reported measurements.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Adopt 2: disciplined caveats prevent overclaiming but do not validate the empirical contribution, and the strongest verified contribution is presently an expository framework rather than decision-ready evidence.

positions: Novelty and experimental reviewers request multi-task, multi-checkpoint, factorial, and broad replication suites.
Other reviews emphasize the smaller requirements of replayable central evidence, exact protocol accounting, multiple stochastic realizations, and a disjoint-pool replication.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: First recover or regenerate the central evidence and test stochastic stability. Require additional models/tasks or factorial ablations only for broader transfer or mechanism claims.

positions: The novelty reviewer treats the partial closest-work audit as a major contribution-level uncertainty.
Experimental and reproducibility reviewers treat citation completion as minor or medium relative to the missing empirical evidence.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Complete a primary-source closest-work audit after the empirical package is fixed, then obtain fresh novelty adjudication; the current restricted record cannot settle distinctness.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: Multiple checkpoints, tasks, and factorial ablations are not necessary to make the paper's explicitly setting-local descriptive claims sound; their absence limits significance and blocks broader claims.

Running every defined arm, including anti_inject and calibration, is not intrinsically required. What is required is an auditable ledger stating whether each arm was run and disclosing every scientifically executed outcome.

prioritized_actions.description: Freeze executable protocol definitions, including candidate-token feedback, tie rules, stochastic coupling, exact scored losses, and the selection/scoring invocation boundary.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Pseudocode and an instrumented toy trace uniquely reproduce every state transition and validate or correct the L/2L ledger.

prioritized_actions.description: Recover a hash-locked replay bundle for every retained result; if recovery fails, rerun the smallest frozen central evaluation and remove claims not regenerated.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A clean replay reproduces retained pool properties, scores, predictions, accuracies, b/c/m counts, stochastic traces, call counts, and tables from resolvable evidence IDs.

prioritized_actions.description: Create a complete arm-by-pool-by-budget-by-realization ledger, separating scientific outcomes from pre-scientific failures and documenting anti_inject status, exclusions, and decision chronology.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Every execution record maps to a disclosed outcome, documented infrastructure failure, or justified exclusion; no scientifically executed result is omitted.

prioritized_actions.description: Under the frozen protocol, run replayable independent mask/reveal realizations and a disjoint-pool replication of the central comparison.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: All realizations and pools are disclosed, reproducible, and show the distribution and reversal frequency of prespecified contrasts.

prioritized_actions.description: Complete a primary-source citation and closest-work audit focused on the claimed protocol-audit dimensions, narrowing distinctness claims where support is absent.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Every citation has verified metadata and local support, and each novelty axis is compared with its closest verified source.

prioritized_actions.description: Define the provenance and ownership of the source-reported records, align package claims with the manifest, rename the non-exhaustive canonical table, and compress repetitive status language.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A blind reader can identify who produced the measurements, what was rerun, what files are available, and which results are complete versus selected.

must_resolve_before_accept: Replay or formally regenerate every retained central empirical claim.
Resolve the scorer definition and L/2L accounting with executable traces.
Disclose a complete evaluated-condition and decision ledger.
Demonstrate stability across replayable stochastic realizations and an independent pool.
Verify the closest-work boundary sufficiently to support the claimed contribution.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Adding more caveat labels or cannot_verify language as a substitute for empirical artifacts.
Treating internal arithmetic consistency as validation of the underlying experiments.
Inflating novelty, certainty, or generality without new verified evidence.
Reporting only favorable arms, budgets, pools, schedules, or subgroups.
Pursuing cosmetic abstract or table edits before resolving provenance, protocol, and replayability.
decision_rationale: All five reviews were verified as round 2 reviews of the specified snapshot. The paper's strongest defensible contribution is its coherent realized-schedule estimand and disciplined protocol/evidence reporting framework. That contribution is clear and internally consistent, but the paper is chiefly empirical and none of its central measurements can be independently connected to an execution or replayed. Missing artifacts demonstrate unverifiability, not falsity; likewise, the call-accounting concern is unresolved rather than a proven error. Even accepting every printed number, one setting, unavailable single stochastic realizations, incomplete arm history, and incomplete novelty verification leave the contribution below the present acceptance threshold. The score is therefore 2, with a current-evidence ceiling of 2.
